description: This Java class 'ModelGrid' models the <grid> element in the OFBiz widget framework. It extends ModelForm and provides methods for accepting visitors and retrieving parent grid models based on XML attributes, supporting a read-only, thread-safe design for representing XML-based UI components.

classes.name: ModelGrid
classes.description: Represents the <grid> element in the widget model, extending ModelForm, with methods for visitor acceptance and parent model retrieval.

methods.name: ModelGrid
methods.description: Constructor initializing ModelGrid with XML element and context objects.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a ModelWidgetVisitor to perform operations on this ModelGrid instance.

methods.name: getParentModel
methods.description: Retrieves the parent grid model based on 'extends-resource' and 'extends' attributes, handling resource expansion and local document search.
